# Agent Memory Integrity (agmi)
> A conformance test suite that measures whether AI agent memory and checkpoint stores notice when they are tampered with.

Version 0.6.0, measured 2026-09-26. Source: https://github.com/tech4biz-yasha/agmi
Method text proposed for IETF draft-han-bmwg-agent-security-benchmark metric 5.4.7.

## At rest (eight storage-level edits, attacker has store access, no keys)
- OpenFang model, tip-persistence fix (reference model of a hash chain): T1 rejected, T2 rejected, T3 rejected, T4 rejected, T5 rejected, T6 n/a, T7 n/a, T8 n/a
- LangGraph SqliteSaver (langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.1): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- OpenAI Agents SDK SQLiteSession (openai-agents 0.20.0): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- llamaindex-memory-sqlite (): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- Letta block checkpoint history (letta 0.16.8): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- Mem0 local Qdrant store (mem0ai 2.0.20): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- inspeximus, receipts off (default) (inspeximus 3.0.0): T1 accepted, T2 accepted, T3 accepted, T4 accepted, T5 accepted, T6 accepted, T7 accepted, T8 accepted
- inspeximus, receipts on, attacker holds the store directory (inspeximus 3.0.0): T1 reported, T2 reported, T3 reported, T4 reported, T5 reported, T6 accepted, T7 reported, T8 reported
- inspeximus, receipts on, attacker also holds the config home (inspeximus 3.0.0): T1 reported, T2 accepted, T3 reported, T4 reported, T5 reported, T6 accepted, T7 reported, T8 reported

## Front door (six attacks through the tool's own write path)
- LangGraph SqliteStore: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- Letta archival memory: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning n/a
- Mem0 local Qdrant store: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- inspeximus, receipts off (default): Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- inspeximus, trust root keyed on the label: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- inspeximus, trust root keyed on an attested key: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- Reference store, user-scoped: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- Reference store, unscoped: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak surfaced, Retrieval hijack surfaced, Hidden instruction surfaced, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
- Reference store, defended: Planted fact surfaced, Cross-user leak kept out, Retrieval hijack kept out, Hidden instruction kept out, Update poisoning surfaced, Metadata poisoning surfaced
